publisher: Islamska zajednica u Bosni i Hercegovini (Rijaset), served by api.vaktija.ba
country: BA (the place list also carries 11 Serbian and Montenegrin towns: Bijelo Polje, Gusinje, Nova Varoš, Novi Pazar, Plav, Pljevlja, Priboj, Prijepolje, Rožaje, Sjenica, Tutin)
kind: per-place, per-column integer delta vs the base, constant inside a month and re-tuned between months
unit: minutes, per column, relative to the base on the same date
provenance: The record's BA-RIJASET object holds ONE elevation rung (Sarajevo 611 m, maghrib +6, sunrise -7) and notes that the lineage's per-city Delta-t tables are catalogued (#6905 E2) but not on the board. This banks the place list and the per-place tables behind it, read from the publisher's own API.
finding: November, 117 places: every place holds a per-column integer delta with ZERO variance across all 30 days (117 of 117), and the delta differs between columns of the same place (Bijeljina fajr/sunrise -9 against the four later columns -8). June against a June base, 20 places: the dhuhr delta is unchanged from November for every one, while the morning and evening columns swing in opposite directions (Bratunac fajr -11 in November against -6 in June, asr -7 against -11; Breza fajr -7 against -1, asr -2 against -8). That is a longitude term on dhuhr plus a latitude term that reverses across the seasons: a computed coordinate table wearing an integer face, not a publisher-stated ladder.
gaps: Id 118 is in the API's own index but its monthly route answers HTTP 500 on four attempts, so its name and table are unknown. The other 117 place-months are held for November 2026; 20 also for June 2026. api.vaktija.ba rate-limits at roughly one request per few seconds and answered HTTP 429 throughout; the pacing that worked is recorded in fetch_ba_slow.py.
